title: Networks of stress, affect and eating behaviour: anticipated stress coping predicts goal-congruent eating in young adults
network_types: temporal network, contemporaneous network, between-subject network
limitations: - Small sample size; - Limited generalizability due to mostly young, female, academic participants; - Self-reported EMA data may reflect self-presentation; - Did not differentiate specific coping styles or food environments.
notes: The paper does not mention preregistration. Code is declared available on request, but data availability is not explicitly stated as publicly accessible. The study used a novel network analysis approach with EMA data.
